bases.description: Complete product ready to operate, with battery, without payload or accessories. Arm = manipulator only, without controller or cabinet. Never package or shipping weight.
Stated without battery.

attributes.question: What is the rated payload?

bases.description: Rated payload as the spec sheet states it. Arm = at the flange/wrist. Mobile manipulator = at the arm's flange. Mobile, legged or humanoid robot = carried while moving. Humanoid = with both arms together. End-effector = held object.
A higher "maximum" figure at reduced reach, speed or posture, when no rated figure exists.
Static or standing load (legged or mobile robot not moving).
One arm of a humanoid or dual-arm robot.
Both arms together, for a dual-arm arm or a mobile manipulator with two arms (their default is one arm at the flange). For a humanoid, both arms together is already the default.
Towed load (AMR / tugger).
Magnetic or vacuum grip with the load acting parallel to the gripping face (shear), when only that figure is given. The default for these grippers is a straight pull off a flat part.

Kompaktlenkung (Skid-Steer): vier oder mehr feste Räder, links und rechts getrennt angetrieben, gelenkt durch Rutschen. Omnidirektional: Mecanum-, Omni- oder Swerve-Räder. Ackermann: gelenkte Räder wie beim Auto. Kettenantrieb: Gleisketten. Selbstbalancierend: zwei Räder auf einer Achse, durch aktive Balance aufrecht gehalten.
